propositions: The close gate allows a bug marked --class duplicate to proceed without a recorded duplicates link, then incorrectly fails the completion verifier with remediation text that never mentions the single working fix: recording the duplicates link via rebar link.

The _completion_precheck function must raise CommandError before any LLM call when a bug is closed --class duplicate and no live replacement link exists, providing the exact rebar link command needed.
A duplicates link whose target is closed (not open) must satisfy the gate's link-existence requirement, allowing the disposition verdict path.
When a duplicates link names an archived or unresolvable target, the error message must distinguish that dead-target case from the no-link case.
The hard fail must be scoped to duplicate class only; not_a_bug and escalated retain their existing fallthrough behavior since they do not require a duplicates link.
Non-duplicate close classes and --force flag must remain unaffected by the new precheck guard.
